### Bio:

I am a graduate student at UCLA studying Data Science in Health, with a background in finance and computer science. My work focuses on analyzing large-scale health data to better understand how socioeconomic and structural factors influence health outcomes and access to care. I am particularly interested in connecting data-driven insights with real-world public health and policy questions.

Outside of academics, I enjoy music and have played instruments such as piano and violin since childhood.
